description.text: Founded in 2000, the International Preparatory Education Program of Peking University (PKU) provides one to two years of training for international students who have graduated from high school and have excellent academic records and are interested in pursuing a bachelor's degree at PKU. Peking University Preparatory School is committed to creating a new pattern of all-round scientific education, and strives to provide professional language training, international cultural exchange, first-class undergraduate integration and other platforms for international students to study in Peking University. After the preparatory study, international students who pass the assessment and meet the standards can be admitted to Peking University for undergraduate studies.

duration.text: The Foundation Programs at Peking University is a 1 Semester long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 300 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3750 USD/per semester ￥ 27000 CNY/per semester

materials.text: 1) Application Form for Admission to Peking University Preparatory Students. After successful online registration, submit and print the application form, sign it, and post a photo;2) Original high school graduation certificate or pre-graduation certificate (study certificate), if the original is not in Chinese or English, the original notarized Chinese or English translation must be submitted;3) Original full transcript of senior high school. If the original is not in Chinese or English, the original notarized copy with Chinese or English translation shall be submitted;4) Personal Statement (please click to download template: Personal Statement, please fill in Chinese or English);5) 2 letters of recommendation, one of which must be from the teacher or class teacher of the applicant's high school, and the other can be selected by the referee, no rank requirement;6) Passport copy, must hold a regular passport valid later than July 2024;7) Application letter of commitment (please click to download template: Letter of commitment, please fill in Chinese or English);8) Non-mandatory materials: including but not limited to SAT/IB/A-Level/ACT transcripts, national college entrance examination transcripts, award certificates, HSK transcripts, other language proficiency certificates and other materials that are considered helpful to the application (photocopies are sufficient).

requirements.text: 1. applicants should be between the ages of 17 and 23, in good physical and mental health, good academic performance, in line with the relevant provisions of the Nationality Law of the People's Republic of China, non-Chinese citizens with valid foreign passports, and no criminal record.Remarks: Whether the applicant has the nationality of the People's Republic of China while having a foreign nationality is subject to the nationality determination conclusion of the Exit and Entry Administration department of the Chinese public security organ. If the applicant is found to have Chinese nationality after the application, admission and enrollment, the application qualification, admission qualification, enrollment registration qualification, study qualification or student status will be cancelled.2. Students with a full-time high school diploma (excluding Chinese ordinary high schools) should, in principle, be trained by overseas basic education systems from primary school to high school;
